text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This is a report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing & Standards in the matter of an application for a boulevard cafe permit located at 796 Bloor Street West, Crawford Street flankage.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the item until its March 12, 2020 meeting.
